source: GOL-13 corrected parity inventory; GOL-20 cutover contract; GOL-21 journey matrix
golden_update_policy: Change this manifest or a fixture only with a version bump and an explicit compatibility reason in the commit and tracker evidence.
compatibility_reason: GOL-24 focused repair: freeze omitted corrected GOL-13 route, installed-toolchain, outside-checkout lifecycle, and launcher semantics; replace credentialed managed-readiness J4 with a credential-free local boundary.

opencode_outside_checkout.command: mcp/channel/index.js resolved from the installed/rendered checkout

launcher_compatibility.golemx: compatibility path remains truthful; unsupported_custom_base_url is ineligible and never claims readiness

capabilities.user_outcome: Start, diagnose, and distinguish dashboard process/API/delivery health.
capabilities.regression: A running process is reported healthy while its API or delivery path is unavailable.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Temporary-home health and dashboard projection journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Managed Codex preserves approvals, canonical thread recovery, and qualified push delivery.
capabilities.regression: A stale supervisor or mismatched App Server contract accepts a control turn.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Version/fingerprint fail-closed, restart, duplicate-envelope, and TUI-thread journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Direct Codex registers useful facts and MCP tools without a false push claim.
capabilities.regression: Pull-only direct Codex is advertised as dispatch-ready.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Render, registration, and pull-only capability journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Claude install/update uses generated source and detects render drift.
capabilities.regression: A stale or hand-edited render silently installs.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Temporary render, tamper, refresh, and rollback journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: A qualified Claude consumer receives addressed work; unqualified clients remain truthful.
capabilities.regression: Transport registration is mistaken for model consumption readiness.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Authenticated channel and model-consumption qualification journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: OpenCode lifecycle and addressed prompt bridge survive resume/retry safely.
capabilities.regression: Resume or stale bridge state resurrects/deletes the wrong session.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Config validation, resume/child identity, retry, deletion, and source-independent render journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Pi work is durable and delivered on next user turn, never mislabeled as push.
capabilities.regression: A crash loses queued work or the UI claims immediate delivery.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Inbox replay, acknowledgement, dead-letter, and next-turn journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Projects resolve consistently across nested roots, worktrees, relocation, and unregistered paths.
capabilities.regression: A broad or ambiguous path merges unrelated projects.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Nested Git, common-dir worktree, relocation, and forbidden-root journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: One logical session remains truthful across resume, metadata changes, terminal events, and leases.
capabilities.regression: Terminal resurrection, duplicate cards, or heartbeat-as-activity.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Generation, ordering, stale-event, and endpoint-fence journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Journal activity remains explainable and dashboard downtime does not lose events.
capabilities.regression: A dashboard outage drops or duplicates a hook event.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Inbox rename, replay-once, and quarantine journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Tickets, comments, phases, streams, links, and history remain durable product contracts.
capabilities.regression: A phase or attribution transition loses tracker history.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Real SQLite tracker migration and phase/idempotency journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Qualified work is delivered once with acknowledgement, retry, and explicit readiness reasons.
capabilities.regression: A duplicate or non-ready delivery creates orphan work.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Busy/waiting/pull/next-turn, retry, ack deadline, and owner-fence journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Subscriptions replay ordered meaningful updates without surprise model turns.
capabilities.regression: Duplicate ingest or offline replay loses/crosses a cursor.
capabilities.cutover_gate: UUID dedupe, cursor ordering, offline replay, and passive-consumption journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Operators retain role, gate, idea, diagnostic, and attachment workflows.
capabilities.regression: A migration drops a human gate, role audit, or actionable diagnostic.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Role activation, human-gate audit, idea promotion, and redaction journey.

capabilities.user_outcome: Compact launcher/preset commands are deterministic; golemc/golemx remain truthful compatibility paths.
capabilities.regression: A wrapper recurses, leaks configuration, or claims unsupported custom-provider readiness.
capabilities.cutover_gate: Preset precedence, dry-run redaction, direct-mode truth, and qualified Claude/Ollama consumption journey.

retirement_candidates.reason: install, cleanup, reinstall, session, project, dispatch, and ack are absent current v3 commands.
JSON registries remain import/export inputs until C4 and must not become canonical authority.
agents-update, tickets-update, agent-detail, and orchestrator-update are removed v3 projection messages.
